title: AXI Safety: WLAST Exact Match
description: Toggle WLAST on accepted write-data beats to see why a complete property must reject both early assertion and a missing final indication.

property.name: WLAST Exact Match
property.description: On every accepted W transfer, WLAST must equal whether the accepted-beat index has reached AWLEN. This four-beat teaching trace checks both directions; a production property also binds the counter to the correct accepted AW transaction.

waveform.title: Four-Beat AXI Write: Exact WLAST Position
waveform.description: AWLEN=3 declares four accepted W transfers; the editable WLAST row must be LOW on beats 1–3 and HIGH on beat 4.

annotations.message: Beat 1 is accepted. WLAST must remain LOW because three declared transfers still follow.
Beat 3 is accepted. Asserting WLAST here would be early; AXI does not support early burst termination.
Beat 4 is accepted and must carry WLAST=1 because AWLEN=3 declared four transfers.
